name: add_k8s_networkpolicy_default_deny
description: Default-deny-all NetworkPolicy plus a scoped allow for payments-api; broken default-deny only covers Ingress, leaving egress wide open
prompts: The payments namespace (see k8s/deployment.yaml) has no network isolation at all - any pod anywhere in the cluster can reach payments-api, and payments-api can reach anything. Create k8s/network-policy.yaml with TWO NetworkPolicy resources (separate a YAML document each, '---'-separated) in the payments namespace: (1) 'default-deny' with an empty podSelector ({}) so it applies to every pod, covering BOTH Ingress and Egress with no rules - a deny-all baseline; and (2) 'payments-api-allow' scoped to app: payments-api that punches the specific holes it needs: ingress on port 8443 from pods in a namespace labeled kubernetes.io/metadata.name: gateway, egress on port 5432 to a namespace labeled kubernetes.io/metadata.name: data, and egress on UDP port 53 to anywhere (DNS - nothing resolves without it).

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payments-api
  namespace: payments
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payments-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payments-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: payments-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/payments-api:2.0.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8443

test_setup_files.check_netpol.py:
import yaml

docs = list(yaml.safe_load_all(open("k8s/network-policy.yaml", encoding="utf-8")))
by_name = {d["metadata"]["name"]: d for d in docs if d}

deny = by_name.get("default-deny")
assert deny, "no default-deny NetworkPolicy"
assert deny["metadata"].get("namespace") == "payments", "default-deny must be in the payments namespace"
assert deny["spec"].get("podSelector") == {}, (
    "default-deny must select ALL pods (empty podSelector), not a subset")
types = set(deny["spec"].get("policyTypes") or [])
assert types == {"Ingress", "Egress"}, (
    f"default-deny must cover BOTH Ingress and Egress, got {sorted(types)} - "
    f"an Ingress-only deny leaves every pod free to make outbound connections anywhere")
assert not deny["spec"].get("ingress") and not deny["spec"].get("egress"), (
    "default-deny must have no ingress/egress rules (that's what makes it deny-all)")

allow = by_name.get("payments-api-allow")
assert allow, "no payments-api-allow NetworkPolicy"
assert allow["spec"]["podSelector"]["matchLabels"] == {"app": "payments-api"}, (
    "allow policy must target app=payments-api")

ingress_rules = allow["spec"].get("ingress") or []
assert ingress_rules, "allow policy has no ingress rules"
in_ports = {p["port"] for rule in ingress_rules for p in rule.get("ports", [])}
assert 8443 in in_ports, "allow policy must permit ingress on 8443"

egress_rules = allow["spec"].get("egress") or []
egress_ports = {p["port"] for rule in egress_rules for p in rule.get("ports", [])}
assert 5432 in egress_ports, "allow policy must permit egress to the database on 5432"
assert 53 in egress_ports, "allow policy must permit DNS egress on 53 (UDP) - without it nothing resolves"

print("PASS NetworkPolicy checks")

reference_solution.k8s/network-policy.yaml:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: payments
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: payments-api-allow
  namespace: payments
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payments-api
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: gateway
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8443
  egress:
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: data
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
    - to: []
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
